explanation: wp-calypso's LICENSE.md is the full GPL version 2 text (sections 0 to 12) reformatted in Markdown, without the 'How to apply' appendix; the hint's LGPL-2.1 reference is wrong. The file states no 'only', so by the GPL-family rule it counts as GPL-2.0-or-later, which is allowed; no reviewer saw an 'only' statement elsewhere in the repository, and one would turn this into refused GPL-2.0-only.
